import os import sqlite3 from datetime import datetime, timezone from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, render_template_string app = Flask(__name__) app.secret_key = os.environ.get("APP_SECRET", "default-secret-key") DB_PATH = "db.sqlite3" HTML_LIST = """ Wiki Entries

Wiki Entries

    {% for entry in entries %}
  • {{ entry.title }}
    • {% endfor %}
""" HTML_ENTRY = """ {{ title }}

{{ title }}

Last modified: {{ lastModifiedAt }} by {{ lastModifiedBy|default('unknown') }}
{{ content|safe }}
← Back to entries """ HTML_EDITS = """ Edit History

Edit History for: {{ title }}

{% for edit in edits %}
{{ edit.timestamp }} by {{ edit.contributor }}
{{ edit.diff|safe }}
{% endfor %}
← Back to entries """ def init_db(): conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) c = conn.cursor() c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS entries ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, lastModifiedBy TEXT, lastModifiedAt TEXT )''') c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS edits ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, entry_id TEXT, contributor TEXT, timestamp TEXT, old_content TEXT, new_content TEXT, diff TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(entry_id) REFERENCES entries(id) )''') conn.commit() conn.close() init_db() @app.route('/entries', methods=['GET']) def list_entries(): conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) c = conn.cursor() c.execute("SELECT id, title FROM entries ORDER BY lastModifiedAt DESC") rows = c.fetchall() conn.close() entries = [{"id": row[0], "title": row[1]} for row in rows] return HTML_LIST, 200 @app.route('/entries/', methods=['GET']) def get_entry(entry_id): conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) c = conn.cursor() c.execute("SELECT id, title, content, lastModifiedBy, lastModifiedAt FROM entries WHERE id = ?", (entry_id,)) row = c.fetchone() conn.close() if not row: return "Entry not found", 404 entry = { "id": row[0], "title": row[1], "content": row[2], "lastModifiedBy": row[3], "lastModifiedAt": row[4] or datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() } return HTML_ENTRY, 200 @app.route('/entries/', methods=['PUT']) def update_entry(entry_id): data = request.get_json(silent=True) if not data: return jsonify({"error": "Invalid request"}), 400 content = data.get("content") modified_by = data.get("modifiedBy") summary = data.get("summary") if not content or not modified_by: return jsonify({"error": "Invalid request"}), 400 conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) c = conn.cursor() # Get old content for diff c.execute("SELECT content FROM entries WHERE id = ?", (entry_id,)) old_row = c.fetchone() old_content = old_row[0] if old_content else "" # Update entry now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() c.execute(""" UPDATE entries SET content = ?, lastModifiedBy = ?, lastModifiedAt = ? WHERE id = ? """, (content, modified_by, now, entry_id)) # Record edit diff = "" if old_content != content: # Simple unified diff-like summary old_lines = old_content.splitlines() new_lines = content.splitlines() if old_lines != new_lines: diff = f"Changed content from '{old_content[:50]}...' to '{content[:50]}...'" else: diff = "Content updated" c.execute(""" INSERT INTO edits (entry_id, contributor, timestamp, old_content, new_content, diff) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) """, (entry_id, modified_by, now, old_content, content, diff)) conn.commit() entry = { "id": entry_id, "title": request.args.get("title", "Untitled"), "content": content, "lastModifiedBy": modified_by, "lastModifiedAt": now } conn.close() return jsonify(entry), 200 @app.route('/entries//edits', methods=['GET']) def get_edits(entry_id): conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) c = conn.cursor() c.execute("SELECT contributor, timestamp, diff FROM edits WHERE entry_id = ? ORDER BY id ASC", (entry_id,)) rows = c.fetchall() conn.close() if not rows: return "No edits found for this entry.", 404 edits = [{"contributor": row[0], "timestamp": row[1], "diff": row[2]} for row in rows] return HTML_EDITS, 200 if __name__ == '__main__': app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=5000)
